messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Incident triggered (P1) — Synth Canary failures in eu-west-1. Alert: synth-canary-eu-west-1/fanout-failures. Firing rate: 73% failed checks over 2m. PD: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 created and assigned to @oncall-eu. Escalation policy: synth-probes.

alice-ops: grabbing this — oncall-eu here. Starting quick triage. Any recent deploys to prober or network in eu-west? :mag_right:

bob-sre: acked PD12345 @pagerduty — I'm on primary. See logs showing 502s from prober fanout to collector pool. Spinning up probes locally to repro.

alice-ops: thx. running a raw probe now:
```bash
curl -v 'https://synth-prober.eu-west-1.internal/check?probe=canary' -H 'x-prober-id: eu-canary-01'
```

alice-ops: raw output: 
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream write: connection reset by peer"}
```

jane-support: FYI CS pinged — 3 customers reported increased lat on chat completions in EU region but no full downtime. They saw intermittent 5xx and higher tail latency. Collecting customer IDs now.

bob-sre: noticed a spike in TCP RSTs between prober and collector-01..collector-04. Could be connection limits on the collector side. Checking iptables and kube-proxy metrics.

metrics-bot: synth-canary-eu-west-1: failures 73% -> 40s ago, request rate 210r/s, successful 57r/s, latency p95 1.9s (baseline 300ms).

alice-ops: quick mitigation idea: throttle fanout (drop non-essential probes) and route canary to global fallback collector. Runbook snippet:
```bash
# reduce fanout concurrency on prober config
kubectl -n prober patch cm prober-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"fanout.concurrency":"10"}}'
# patch rollout to prober pods
kubectl rollout restart deploy/prober-eu-west
```

ops-bot: Executing patch: prober-config updated, rollout started for prober-eu-west (3/3 pods restarting). :hammer_and_wrench:

bob-sre: I'm going to cordon collector-03 and bounce it — it's showing memory pressure and many CLOSE_WAIT sockets.

ops-bot: Collector collector-03 cordoned and pod restart initiated.

carol-oncall: stepping in for handoff @alice-ops — I'm now on second-line. Watching metrics.

metrics-bot: post-mitigation: failures down to 28% after patch, request rate stable 195r/s, p95 720ms. Prober backlog decreasing.

bob-sre: collector-03 restart came back healthy, CLOSE_WAIT cleared. Kernel tcp_retries decreased. I also bumped collector accept queue from 128 -> 512 on node pool.

alice-ops: nice. I'll create a PagerDuty note with the mitigation steps and mark for timeline.

pagerduty-bot: Note added to PD12345: "throttled prober fanout, rolled prober-eu-west, restarted collector-03, increased accept queue".

jane-support: customer impact update: three enterprise customers (cust-A, cust-B, cust-C) saw degraded request success for ~13m window. No data loss, just elevated lat/5xx spikes. Preparing inbound update to account managers.

bob-sre: root cause hypothesis: sudden fanout spike + one degraded collector exhausted connection table -> upstream write failures. Short term fix applied. Long term: add circuit-breaker and per-node connection limits + autoscale collector on file descriptors.

alice-ops: agreed. Action items: 1) postmortem (owner: bob-sre), 2) runbook update with fanout circuit-breaker (owner: alice-ops), 3) make collector pod file-descriptor alert more visible (owner: carol-oncall). I'll add to the incident ticket.

carol-oncall: adding PD escalation note and silencing duplicate synth-canary alerts while investigating (15m).

ops-bot: Alert suppression applied: synth-canary-eu-west-1 suppressed for 15m.

metrics-bot: stabilization: failures 7% and trending down, p95 340ms now.

bob-sre: moving to post-incident work. If metrics stay green for 30m with no regressions we can resolve PD.

alice-ops: +1. thank you team. great quick coordination. :white_check_mark:

jane-support: I'll send a short customer-facing blurb to account teams and attach in the incident.

carol-oncall: I'll monitor the next hour and then hand back to primary oncall. If anything flares I'll tag this thread.

alice-ops: closing thread for now — PD12345 will be resolved once stable for 30m. Postmortem to follow in #postmortems with RCA and playbook changes.

incident-bot: PD12345 marked as stable. Awaiting confirmation for resolve
